dynamic_profile.target_words: approximately 599–949 words, unless tables/bullets carry the disclosure efficiently
depth_focus: explain supported evidence in decision-useful IFRS S1/S2 report prose
connect governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics only where evidence supports the connection
prefer compact tables or bullets for numeric evidence without padding unsupported narrative
avoid boilerplate, absence-language, raw dataset fields, and unsupported future commitments
dynamic_profile.policy: Depth is evidence-aware; do not pad with unsupported boilerplate.

warnings.claim: Sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities are integrated into the organisation’s enterprise risk management processes.
Climate-related considerations are embedded into decision-making on major transactions through a climate check applied to major transactions.

claims.claim_text: The Board is responsible for oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.support_notes: Identifies the governance body responsible for oversight, but does not describe how responsibilities are reflected in terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: The Board comprises 10 directors and holds four full Board meetings per year.
claims.support_notes: Provides governance structure and meeting frequency, but does not directly evidence how/how often the Board is informed about sustainability/climate risks and opportunities (separate reporting cadence claim covers that).
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related matters are integrated into Board oversight through routine agenda coverage and consideration of specific climate topics in Board discussions.
claims.support_notes: Describes integration into oversight, but does not explicitly address major transactions/risk management integration/trade-offs within this claim (covered elsewhere).
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related items represented 69.8% of Board agenda coverage.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies agenda coverage, supporting evidence of Board consideration of climate matters; does not by itself demonstrate how climate risks/opportunities are taken into account in strategy/transactions/risk processes.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Board discussions evidenced oversight of climate-related strategy, risk and performance topics including transition plan review, scenario analysis, review of climate-related disclosures aligned to TCFD, monitoring progress against net zero progress, approval of carbon credits, and executive remuneration and ESG KPIs.
claims.support_notes: Lists oversight topics relevant to strategy, resilience (scenario analysis), disclosures, targets/progress and remuneration; does not specify formal mechanisms (e.g., policies/mandates) or trade-off consideration.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting is provided to the Board on a semi-annual basis through a defined reporting cadence.
claims.support_notes: Directly addresses how often the governance body is informed about climate-related risks and opportunities.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: An ESG committee is in place at Board level.
claims.support_notes: Identifies a governance body supporting oversight, but does not describe responsibilities in terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: The ESG committee met five times per year in one reporting period, increasing to six and then seven meetings per year in subsequent periods.
claims.support_notes: Shows committee activity frequency, which can support governance oversight; does not explicitly state the committee is the channel by which the Board is informed about risks/opportunities.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Management’s role in monitoring, managing and overseeing sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities is delegated to a management-level committee.
claims.support_notes: Directly addresses delegation of management oversight to a management-level committee.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Across the periods evidenced, the management committee responsible for oversight is identified as the Group Sustainability Committee, ESG Executive Committee, and Climate Risk Management Committee.
claims.support_notes: Identifies management-level committees, but does not explain how oversight is exercised over the committee(s) or their specific remit/controls.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities are integrated into the organisation’s enterprise risk management processes.
claims.support_notes: States ERM integration, supporting disclosure on how governance takes risks into account and how controls integrate with internal functions; lacks detail on specific controls/procedures and integration mechanics.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related considerations are embedded into decision-making on major transactions through a climate check applied to major transactions.
claims.support_notes: Addresses consideration in major transactions; does not describe trade-offs or how the Board applies/oversees the climate check in practice.

claims.claim_text: The Board’s oversight includes monitoring progress on climate-related objectives, evidenced by Board discussion of net zero progress.
claims.support_notes: Supports monitoring progress toward targets, but does not describe how targets are set or the specific governance process for monitoring.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related performance metrics are linked to executive remuneration; the proportion linked to climate-related measures was 8.7%, 15.3% and 15.1% across the periods evidenced.
claims.support_notes: Provides quantitative linkage to remuneration; does not specify which metrics, how they are measured, or governance oversight mechanics beyond Board discussion.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Across the periods evidenced, the proportion of the Board with climate-related expertise was 33.5%, 35.5% and 37.5%.
claims.support_notes: Quantifies climate expertise, supporting skills/competency disclosure; does not explain how the Board determines skills are appropriate or how skills will be developed.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme is in place to support development of competencies relevant to sustainability-related and climate-related oversight.
claims.support_notes: States existence of a programme, supporting competency development; lacks detail on how needs are assessed, programme scope, frequency, or outcomes.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

claims.claim_text: Governance maturity indicators summarise: Board climate expertise 37.5%, ERM integration of climate-related risks and opportunities, and ESG committee meeting frequency of seven meetings per year.
claims.support_notes: Summarises earlier claims; indicators are not, by themselves, evidence of required governance disclosures without underlying detail.
claims.evidence_repair_note: Added by deterministic path repair from disclosure-plan evidence paths.

gates.policy: V8.9 treats LLM claim-builder support false negatives as warnings after deterministic evidence repair; factlock still blocks unsupported report numbers.
